note: Pre-registration only. No behaviour comparison has been run. criteria is the single machine-readable source of every gate; criteria_sha256 is SHA-256 over its canonical JSON and must be recomputable. Pricing measurements are read-only in-memory loads; no parent was produced.

authority.budget_source: plans/reference/CLOSEOUT-TAIJI_U2_LEARNING_CALIBRATION_20261113.md (P3.8 unallocated 790 CPU: engineering 130 / runner 600 / final audit 60)
authority.owner_authorisation: standing authorisation to execute the current plan; this card is the pricing and pre-registration gate, not training admission

parent.note: P3.8.2b committed only inside isolated shadow runtimes and wrote no accepted parent; the comparison parent is therefore still the frozen P3.7 research parent

criteria.question: On the same Native parent and the same public inputs, does the WHOLE recipe (content credit + accepted parameter update) improve first-question and actual-two-question behaviour over the whole original recipe (byte objective + plain Adam), per real CPU and sample exposure?

A_original.update: plain Adam, lr=1e-3, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0, no acceptance test, no alpha search

B_credit.objective: J_first = first_ce + J_content, with J_content = -w_y*logsumexp_b(log(omega_b)+log_softmax(W_c h_b+b_c)_y)
B_credit.update: taiji.u2_credit_update.accepted_adam_step with the frozen v2 alpha grid, armijo=1e-4, tolerance=1e-6 and the fallback direction rule
B_credit.content_head: Linear(8,4), 36 parameters, seed 2026111311, absent from runtime

arms.ablation_limit: this is a whole-recipe comparison; without a separate content-only or acceptance-only arm no verdict may attribute a gain to content supervision or to the search individually

identity_and_inputs.allowed_partition: train only for updates and acceptance; dev only for the frozen endpoint scoring

parity.primary: equal sample exposure: both arms see the same 128 ordered train episodes with the same seed and the same data order
parity.cpu_accounting: real CPU and wall are billed per arm and reported separately with cpu_ratio; equality of parameter count is NOT accepted as compute parity
parity.on_failure: if cpu_ratio > 2.0, either arm exceeds 240 CPU, or the two arms cannot be compared at matched exposure, stop with compute_parity_unavailable; do not enlarge the cheaper arm to win
parity.timing: single-thread, repeat-mean >=8 samples, median frozen before reading; Windows 15.6 ms timer granularity handled explicitly

dose.budget_basis: largest update count whose conservative estimate (461.7749 CPU) fits the 600 CPU runner budget; 256 would cost 922.5749
dose.stop_rule: budget gate at 600 CPU / 1200 wall; no shrink-and-rerun, no dose increase after reading
dose.no_escalation: if both arms sit on the floor or are bit-identical, the verdict is budget_cannot_express, NOT a negative result and NOT a reason to add dose

evaluation.legacy_scope: P3.8.1 first-round complete denominator, RGB/question necessity and descriptive ranges stay on their original contracts
evaluation.no_formal_A: the formal A multi-entity / 3-seed / independent-check gate still needs its own parent and scope; this card does not sign it

gates.dynamic_range_required: arm A must produce a non-zero, non-chance endpoint on at least one face; otherwise neither a pass nor a negative verdict is valid
gates.retention: Task1 C12 structural capability must not regress; learned-then-retained old capability remains unmeasured and is registered as such

checkpoint_preflight.before_any_optimizer_step: initial full NativeLearnerCapsule must save and restore in an independent process with matching digest
checkpoint_preflight.first_nonempty_moment: repeat the full independent-process restore immediately after the first real Adam call of each arm
checkpoint_preflight.on_failure: engineering_failure; stop the card, keep incurred cost

budget.note: budget is taken from the frozen P3.8 unallocated 790; no transfer from P3.9, no new cap

decision_rule.recipe_gain: both faces report delta = acc_B - acc_A; pass requires delta >= 0.05 AND paired bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 on the primary face, with arm A showing dynamic range, matched exposure and parity; signs only a recipe-level comparative result, not a capability
decision_rule.recipe_no_gain: arm A has dynamic range and delta <= 0 or the confidence lower bound <= 0; range-limited negative, not 'impossible'
decision_rule.inconclusive: confidence interval crosses zero with arm A dynamic range, or the two faces disagree
decision_rule.budget_cannot_express: both arms sit at floor/chance or produce bit-identical endpoints; this is insufficient budget to express the hypothesis, not a rejection
decision_rule.compute_parity_unavailable: matched exposure or CPU parity cannot be achieved under the frozen budget
decision_rule.engineering_failure: parent/source/digest mismatch, checkpoint preflight or first-non-empty-moment restore failure, headless leakage, non-finite state
decision_rule.budget_stop: cpu >= 600 or wall >= 1200; keep all cost, no shrink-and-rerun
decision_rule.comparison_not_admitted: a frozen prerequisite is missing at the pre-run gate

stop_line.decision_to_owner: Whether to execute the 128-update comparison under this frozen contract (CPU <= 600). Admission is not execution and execution is not a milestone close.
